title: Hiveeyes Reading Weekly Temperature Trend
dataSources: Beehive telemetry (`beehive:reading`), coop door (`chickencoop:door`), egg counts (`egg:count`), livestock tags (`livestock:tag`), feed level (`feed:level`), pasture sensors (`pasture:sensor`), trail cams (`trailcam:detection`).
app: Homestead sensors — connected beehive scale/temperature/sound, automatic chicken-coop door, egg counter, livestock GPS/health tags, feed-silo level, and pasture soil sensors — via MQTT and LoRaWAN gateways.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hiveeyes:reading temp_c=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(temp_c) as avg_duration, max(temp_c) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst temperature for Hiveeyes reading events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture temp_c on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average temperature with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It scans whether Hiveeyes reading tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
